title: Private investment announcements jump 58.5% to ₹26.6 trn in H1 FY27: CII
description:
Private sector project announcements surged 58.5 per cent year-on-year to Rs 26.6 lakh crore in the first half of FY27 ended September, reflecting improving investor confidence amid sustained government reforms, infrastructure development and regulatory improvements, CII said on Tuesday.
According to the second edition of CII's Private Investment Barometer, private sector announcements accounted for 86.2 per cent of total project announcements during April-September 2026, up from 74.2 per cent in the corresponding period last year.
The investment announcements during the first half of FY27 were 4.4 times the average recorded in the first halves of FY17 to FY25, indicating a strengthening investment pipeline.
CII President R Mukundan said the government's sustained policy reforms, infrastructure development and improvements in the regulatory framework have created a strong enabling environment for private investment.
